title: Full Creative Control Within Brief
tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription includes unrelated Japanese speech, “炒める。” (“stir-fry”), which does not fit the watering scene.

judge.summary: A polished six-second rooftop scene shows a tiny robot watering a sunflower, with unrelated speech as the only notable distraction.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
must_haves.why: One output video is listed with a duration of 6 seconds.

must_haves.item: A tiny robot is visibly present.
must_haves.why: A small green robot is clearly visible beside the flowerpot throughout the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
must_haves.why: The plant has a large yellow flower with a dark seed-filled center, clearly recognizable as a sunflower.

must_haves.item: The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.
must_haves.why: The robot holds and tips a copper watering can, and a visible stream reaches the soil around the sunflower in multiple frames.
